title: Ground radar finds debris field and voids in mesa

tellings.quote: there's there's both a debris field of material that does not fit, that is um unusual,

plain: Ground-penetrating radar, which looks beneath the earth's surface, is said to have found a debris field of unusual material and empty spaces inside a mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings. The ranch's owner tells this himself, describing material that "does not fit" and is "unusual." If true, it would point to something buried in the mesa, which the episode frames as possibly a craft under the ranch.
